entry.title: Music :: RE: [VGM pack] Special Criminal Investigation
entry.dc:creator: kuja45
entry.dc:subject: Music
entry.content:
Author: kuja45
Subject: Special Criminal Investigation: About the track called ‘unused’
Posted: Mon Nov 09, 2026 9:56 am (GMT 0)

I think I’ve worked out what the music in the game corresponds to.
In the game, it plays when you catch up with the car you’re chasing.
And on the album “[PCCB-00024] Special
Criminal Investigation”, it should be the track “Main Theme”, which would make sense if you follow the logic of Chase H.Q.
But in the arcade game there are so many sound effects that you can hardly hear the music at all, so it’s quite difficult to confirm.

Phantasy Star Gaiden is a Sega Game Gear role-playing game developed by Japan System Supply and published by Sega. A spin-off of the popular Phantasy Star series, it was released exclusively in Japan in October 1992.

New translations:
- English
- French
- German
- Spanish
- Italian
- Dutch
- Portuguese (Brazil)
- Danish
- Catalan

Andrs wrote
Hello everyone!
This is my first post in this community and I want to share with you a little game that I've just published, after months of learning/programming with CVBasic. It started as a remake of an MSX-BASIC game, and my initial intention was to make a native MSX version only but, since CVBasic supports various Z80/TMS9918 systems, I ended up making a SG-1000 version as well. Here's the link:

https://andrs-mc.itch.io/obake-sg1000

And here's the link to the MSX/MSX2 version, which you can play online:

https://andrs-mc.itch.io/obake-msx

The only differences between the two are that they use different music routines, and that the MSX version supports the keyboard to enter the player's name (in the SG-1000 version you have to select the letters with the controller).

The download also includes ColecoVision, Spectravideo, Sord M5 and Casio PV-2000 versions. Only the MSX version is tested on real harware, but they are all thoroughly tested on emulation. If you have the chance to play it on a real a SG-1000 or Master System, let me know!

I hope you like it.
Cheers!

-- Andr[é]s MC. [ https://andrs-mc.itch.io ]
